review_scope: static: retail instructions and emitted candidate listing

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: 43 bytes, 16 instructions, one block, zero edges; generated artifacts match 1/0.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Three cdecl arguments; retail loads the third first (from [esp+0x10] after the push), pushes it, then loads the second the same way, then pushes context and index, so the slot receives (index, context, argument2, argument3).

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: One indirect call through record+0x18 (0x009436C8) after the index*0x8C computation, add esp,0x10, pop esi, ret.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: 0x8C stride and +0x18 slot displacement, both read from the lea/scale sequence and the call displacement.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Returns the slot's EAX; no branch and only ESI is saved.

limitations: Runtime unobserved; the slot is populated only once the qfile init chain lands, so this build calls a null slot.
The slot's return type is unproven.
The argument re-read idiom (loading via [esp+0x10] twice) is transcribed as two arguments rather than one reused local, because retail pushes it twice.
